name: Zoe Lofgren
committees: House Science, Space, and Technology (Ranking Member)
stance: As House Science ranking member, pushes frontier-AI safeguards — internal controls, cybersecurity, independent governance — and faults House leadership for not floor-voting the committee's AI bills.

statements.text: Convened a bipartisan House Science Committee roundtable with Hugging Face, METR, OpenAI and Anthropic on recent AI loss-of-control incidents and building an AI governance strategy.
We have to develop policy interventions that improve internal control, robust cybersecurity, and incentivize good governance for frontier AI systems.
The Science Committee passed 10 AI bills through Committee that address the AI boom and the risks that come with it.

review.note: added October 2026 from lofgren.house.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
